新增:
选择图片
点按图片查看大图，点圆圈选中；从圆圈拖动可连续选中多张，双指缩放调整每行的数量。选好的图片排在底部，可拖动调整顺序；也可以直接拍照，或编辑后再发送

只看楼主与倒序
楼层标题旁新增倒序按钮；楼层标题滚入顶栏后，顶栏显示只看楼主与倒序两个开关，帖子菜单中使用相同的图标
改进:
按压反馈
按钮、卡片与列表的按下效果统一：页面上的控件轻轻按下，悬浮的玻璃随手指鼓起并在按下处发亮；菜单从按下的按钮中展开

列表滚动
支持高刷新率的手机上，慢速滚动列表也保持高帧率

帖子卡片
底部按钮行与上下内容的间距更均匀；回复的作者名改用浅色，与回复内容区分开

标签栏
搜索页改用与其他页面一致的玻璃标签栏，与搜索框等宽，并跟随经典样式；选择精华分类时，标签名称与宽度平滑变化
修复: 部分吧的头像显示为贴吧默认图标
打开图片或视频时，屏幕亮度突然升高
帖子卡片上的分享按钮点按无反应；搜索结果中，卡片底部的按钮均无反应
快速滑动切换首页标签后，点按底栏无法回到对应页面
屏幕较窄或调大显示大小时，关注的吧只显示一列
空页面与出错页面的内容偏向左侧
吧内切换精华分类或排序后，列表看起来没有变化
帖子中切换只看楼主或倒序时，阅读位置跳到别处
经典样式下，顶栏按钮按下没有反馈
标签的选项菜单收起时，箭头要等菜单完全消失才转回
更新页面中没有显示当前版本的更新说明

New:
Picking pictures
Tap a picture to see it large, and its circle to pick it; drag from a circle to pick several in a row, and pinch to change how many fit in a row. Picked pictures line up along the bottom, where they can be dragged into another order. You can also take a photo, or edit a picture before sending it

Author's posts and newest first
A newest-first button now sits beside the floors' heading; once the heading scrolls into the top bar, the bar shows switches for the author's posts and the order, and the thread menu uses the same icons
Improved:
Pressing
Buttons, cards and lists respond to a press the same way: controls on the page press in, and floating glass swells towards your finger and lights up where it was touched. Menus open out of the button pressed

Scrolling
On phones with a high refresh rate, lists keep a high frame rate even when scrolled slowly

Thread cards
The row of buttons at the bottom is spaced evenly from the content; a reply's author name is in a lighter colour, set apart from the reply

Tabs
Search uses the same glass tab bar as other pages, as wide as the search field and following the classic style; picking a class of good threads changes the tab's name and width smoothly
Fixed: Some forums' avatars showed Tieba's default icon
Opening a picture or video suddenly raised the screen's brightness
The share button on thread cards did nothing; in search results, none of a card's buttons did
After quickly swiping between home tabs, tapping the bottom bar didn't go back to that page
On narrow screens or with a larger display size, followed forums showed one to a row
Empty and error screens leant to the left
Switching a forum's class of good threads or its order looked as if nothing had changed
Switching to the author's posts or the other order in a thread jumped away from where you were reading
In the classic style, top bar buttons showed nothing when pressed
A tab's options arrow only turned back once its menu had fully gone
The update page showed no notes for the installed version
